summary: 3D paper-marbling art puzzle, v2 with the master's critique, seals and ranks, built by Claude Fable 5.1 · Kıvamlı suda boya serp, tara, şekil ver: v2'de ustanın eleştirisi, mühürler ve dereceler olan 3D ebru bulmacası, Claude Fable 5.1 yaptı
key_features: Deterministic mathematical-marbling simulation: drops push older paint outward, the awl leaves a chevron wake, the comb pulls 25 tines; colours never mix
18 lessons in 3 chapters (basic, combed, flower ebru); every target is a replayed stroke recipe, so every lesson is solvable

v2: the master's critique names the two worst pigment deviations live and on the result card; master's seals and a cirak / kalfa / usta rank; water thickness in the free tray; Bind it book-cover composite
Live match %, ghost hint of the next stroke, up to 3 stars per lesson (54 in all); paint rasterised on the GPU with a stencil pass, 58-60 fps on an Intel UHD 620
The ?auto bot solved 18/18 lessons with 48/54 stars and 12/18 seals through the same stroke API as a player; one index.html, everything generated in code
